reviewer_target: Reviewer 3, comment 2: internal held-fold fusion inputs versus final five-model-averaged deployment inputs.
scientific_status: post-hoc mechanistic sensitivity analysis on the historically exposed fixed HAM test; not new independent validation
question: Does replacing one-model-per-branch OOF-like probability inputs with five-model-per-branch mean probabilities materially change the frozen residual fusion input distribution, calibration, or predictive behavior?

frozen_system.branch_aggregation_deployment: arithmetic mean of five ConvNeXt fold probabilities and five DINOv2 fold probabilities before fusion
frozen_system.fusion_architecture: 14-input non-affine LayerNorm -> Linear(14,64) -> GELU -> Dropout(0.15, disabled at inference) -> Linear(64,7); correction added to ConvNeXt log-probabilities
frozen_system.calibration: single frozen scalar temperature after fusion-seed probability averaging

configurations.DEPLOYMENT: F(mean_k ConvNeXt_k, mean_k DINO_k), average 3 fusion seeds, then frozen temperature
configurations.SINGLE_k: F(ConvNeXt_k, DINO_k) for k=0..4, average 3 fusion seeds, then the same frozen temperature
configurations.OUTPUT_AVERAGED_ALTERNATIVE: For each k compute the pre-calibrated 3-seed fusion probability; arithmetic-mean those five fused probabilities; then apply the same frozen temperature. This isolates order-of-operations: F(mean inputs) versus mean F(single inputs).

primary_comparison.paired_uncertainty: 10,000 lesion-cluster bootstrap replicates on the fixed HAM test

same_image_input_shift_diagnostics: ConvNeXt max-probability shift SINGLE_k minus five-model mean
DINOv2 max-probability shift SINGLE_k minus five-model mean
ConvNeXt entropy shift SINGLE_k minus five-model mean
DINOv2 entropy shift SINGLE_k minus five-model mean
Jensen-Shannon divergence between SINGLE_k and five-model mean for each branch
Euclidean distance after the exact 14-dimensional non-affine LayerNorm used by the fusion network
fusion_output_shift_diagnostics: Jensen-Shannon divergence between each SINGLE_k fused output and DEPLOYMENT
Jensen-Shannon divergence between OUTPUT_AVERAGED_ALTERNATIVE and DEPLOYMENT
training_input_reference: Phase11D development OOF ConvNeXt/DINO probabilities are summarized descriptively as the historical one-held-fold-per-image input distribution. No development labels are used to tune or alter the frozen system.
integrity_rules: No recalibration or new temperature fitting.
No model, seed, fold, or metric selection based on the result.
All five SINGLE_k results are reported, regardless of direction.
The fixed HAM test is described as historically exposed and used only for mechanistic sensitivity.
The deployment reproduction must match the previously frozen Phase11F fusion probabilities before any interpretation.
